teaser.en: Break it and it bleeds milk: the Digo group this mushroom with milky plants like asthma weed.
teaser.sw: Uvunje na unatoa maziwa: Wadigo huuweka uyoga huu pamoja na mimea yenye maziwa kama mziwaziwa.
teaser.dg: Uchiuvundza unalavya maziya: Adigo anauika uoga huno fungu mwenga na mimea yenye maziya dza *chiziyaziya*.

summary.en: Nimaziya are the milk caps, Lactarius mushrooms that ooze a milky juice when the gills are cut. The Digo name places them with the milk-latex plants.
summary.sw: Nimaziya ni uyoga wa maziwa, uyoga wa jenasi *Lactarius* unaotoa utomvu kama maziwa matamvua yanapokatwa. Jina la Kidigo linauweka pamoja na mimea yenye utomvu wa maziwa.
summary.dg: *Nimaziya* ni uoga wa *Lactarius* (kpwa Chingereza *milk caps*), unaolavya madzi dza maziya miraba ichikatwa. Dzina ra Chidigo rinauika fungu mwenga na mimea yenye maziya.

about.en: *Nimaziya* are milk caps. They look much like the brittlegills, with a firm cap, often funnel-shaped when mature, and crowded gills running a little down the stem. Their giveaway is the milk: cut or break the gills and drops of white or coloured latex appear.
about.sw: *Nimaziya* ni uyoga wa maziwa. Unafanana sana na uyoga wa jenasi *Russula*, wenye kofia ngumu, ambayo mara nyingi huwa na umbo la faneli ukikomaa, na matamvua yaliyosongamana yanayoshuka kidogo kwenye shina. Kinachoutambulisha ni maziwa: kata au vunja matamvua na matone ya utomvu mweupe au wenye rangi hutokea.
about.dg: *Nimaziya* ni uoga wa *milk caps*. Unahalana sana na *nimakoba* (*Russula*): una kofiya ngumu, ambayo mara nyinji ichikula inakala na umbo dza chifumbu, na miraba minji iriyo phephi na phephi, inayotserera chidide kpwenye muhi. Unamanyikana kpwa maziyage: uchikata au uchivundza miraba, kunatuluka matone ga maziya mereru au ga rangi.

where.en: Milk caps grow from the ground in woodland, linked to the roots of trees. In eastern and southern Africa many grow with *Brachystegia* trees, and Digo collectors treat *Brachystegia* woodland (*mirihini*) as a mushroom ground.
where.sw: Uyoga wa maziwa huota kutoka ardhini msituni, ukiungana na mizizi ya miti. Mashariki na kusini mwa Afrika, mingi huota pamoja na miti ya *Brachystegia*, na wakusanyaji wa Kidigo huuchukulia msitu wa *Brachystegia* (*mirihini*) kuwa eneo la uyoga.
where.dg: Uoga wa *Lactarius* unamera kula photsi matsakani, phamwenga na mizi ya mihi. Afrika ya Mashariki na ya Kusini, aina nyinji zinamera phamwenga na mirihi (*Brachystegia*), na Adigo anaotsola uoga anaona phatu phenye mirihi (*mirihini*) kukala ni phatu pha uoga.

uses.en: Pakia lists *nimaziya* among the named mushrooms, which are those collected for food. Wild mushrooms should only be eaten when identified by someone with expert local knowledge.
uses.sw: Pakia anaiorodhesha *nimaziya* miongoni mwa uyoga wenye majina, ambao ndio unaokusanywa kwa chakula. Uyoga wa porini unapaswa kuliwa tu ukiwa umetambuliwa na mtu mwenye ujuzi wa kina wa kienyeji.
uses.dg: Pakia anaandika *nimaziya* kahi ya aina za uoga zenye madzina, ambazo ndizo zinazotsolwa kpwa chakurya. Uoga wa weruni taufwaha kuriwa hadi umanyikane ni mutu mwenye ujuzi mkulu wa uoga wa phapha.

culture.en: The Digo group plants by their secretions as well as their uses. Pakia records a group called *m*/*chiziya*, 'milk', for plants that produce milky latex: *mziyaziya* (*Hunteria zeylanica*), *chiziyaziya* (*Euphorbia hirta*) and the mushroom *nimaziya*.
culture.sw: Wadigo hupanga mimea katika makundi kwa vitu inavyotoa pamoja na matumizi yake. Pakia anarekodi kundi liitwalo *m*/*chiziya*, 'maziwa', kwa mimea inayotoa utomvu kama maziwa: *mziyaziya* (*Hunteria zeylanica*), *chiziyaziya* (*Euphorbia hirta*) na uyoga *nimaziya*.
culture.dg: Adigo anaika mimea mafungu kpwa vitu inavyolavya, na piya kpwa vira inavyohumirwa. Pakia anaandika fungu rinaroihwa *m*/*chiziya*, 'maziya', ra mimea inayolavya maziya: *mziyaziya* (*Hunteria zeylanica*), *chiziyaziya* (*Euphorbia hirta*) na uoga *nimaziya*.

names.en: Pakia records *nimaziya*, grouped with the milk-latex plants; *maziya* is the Digo word for milk. The prefix *nima-* is one Pakia reads as carrying a 'female' sense. In English they are milk caps.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi *nimaziya*, uliowekwa pamoja na mimea yenye utomvu wa maziwa; *maziya* ni neno la Kidigo la maziwa. Pakia anakisoma kiambishi *nima-* kuwa kinabeba maana ya 'kike'. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *milk caps*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *nimaziya*, uoga unaoikpwa fungu mwenga na mimea yenye maziya; *maziya* ni neno ra Chidigo, na kpwa Chingereza ni *milk*. Pakia anaona kukala mwandzo wa dzina hiri, *nima-*, una mana ya chichetu. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *milk caps*.
